pages.text: Capes are cosmetics you earn, not items: nothing to craft, nothing to lose. Everyone on the server sees the cape you wear. Some capes have a $(bold)perk$() while worn; the legendary ones are $(bold)animated$().$(br2)$(bold)Wardrobe:$() ESC → Capes, or $(#e0ac46)/capes$(). It lists what you have unlocked; click a cape to wear it, or $(#e0ac46)/capes off$() for none. Unlocks announce themselves in chat.

pages.title: Skill capes
pages.text: One per skill, at level 99. Each has a perk while worn.
